correctness.operation: out-of-place contiguous row-major FP32 transpose: B[col*rows+row]=A[row*cols+col]
correctness.comparison: independent nested-row/column CPU oracle; all final payload words bitwise compared, finite counts and both 32-word guards checked
correctness.input_scope: one deterministic position-unique float32 input, repeated checks are not different random inputs
correctness.boundary_scope: same 19 shapes including skinny, 63/64/65 and large ragged matrices

measurement.timed_scope: default-stream events around 10 launches; may include device idle gaps during host submission
measurement.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
measurement.transfer_scope: allocation, initialization, transfers and file writes outside event intervals
measurement.throughput_scope: logical read+write bytes; not measured DRAM traffic
measurement.function_attribute_query: before each case's warmups and timing; runtime observations, not occupancy measurements
measurement.wave_size_note: MACA 3.5.3 headers alias waveSize to warpSize; one API observation
measurement.control: one non-template kernel, 4160-float source shared allocation, runtime pitch 64 versus 65
measurement.analysis_unit: process; same-shape ratio of ten-batch medians, then median[min,max] over ten processes
measurement.balance: each of five shapes at each shape-position twice, once with each variant order; no full carryover balance claim
measurement.shared_address_basis: Pitch 64 uses slots 0..4095; pitch 65 uses 4096 slots up to 4158. Both are in a 4160-element source capacity; active addresses/span differ. No per-instruction address trace.
measurement.device_buffers: same input/output device allocations reused across each process

limitations: Equal reported shared capacity and register count do not establish equal actual occupancy or identify a bank mechanism.
The active shared addresses/span still change with pitch.
Comparisons to previous specialized kernels also change code generation; this study cannot attribute their earlier effect entirely to capacity.
No C550 bank count,width,conflict degree or hardware memory-transaction counters were established.
Runtime data-cache policy and fixed frequency remain unverified; same-source code does not mean system-wide isolation.
Trace duration units remain unverified, with no conversion applied.
One card and compiler build; no in-place,other-dtype,arbitrary-stride or target-framework qualification.
